title: Curious Urgency 53
author: bpatrick
html:
A little Curious for Jonny Paycheck. Sorry it’s so late, Jonny.

I’m working on some other stuff too. Hopefully I’ll be updating more.

comments.author: Gogo Yubari
comments.html:
Waiting 3 months between these is torturous.

But they’re amazing so it’s worth it. Keep up the amazing work.

comments.author: Jonny Paycheck
comments.html: Always glad to see Sheriff Chuck and hear whispers of future comics. Gotta figure out how to get you into a comic-writing craze. If you need to free up some time, try not sleeping.

comments.author: Jonny Paycheck
comments.html: Changed computers and put in wrong email. Just testing if my ugly mug is still on here.

comments.author: Jonny Paycheck
comments.html: Just seen the good news about the Bob&Bob film on facebook. Maybe you’ll have to quit being a comic artist to become a film writer.

comments.author: b.patrick
comments.html: I can never quit comics, Jonny. It’s a compulsion. Thanks for letting me know about Bob & Bob, though. That is awesome!
